Cluster 1 · Genetics, Rootstocks & Canopy

Grape Varieties & Rootstocks in India (110R vs Dogridge + Y-Trellis)

Direct Answer · Grape Varieties & Rootstocks in India

Thompson Seedless and its clones (Tas-A-Ganesh, Sonaka, Manik Chaman, Clone 2A) cover ~79% of India’s vineyards. Under saline borewells, ICAR-NRCG Pune proved Dogridge accumulates Sodium (Na⁺) and causes Year 4–5 dead cordons — choose 110R (or B2-56) on an Extended Y-Trellis (899–981 vines/acre) [ICAR-NRCG; APEDA 2026].

Indian Grape Rootstock Comparison: Why 110R Beats Dogridge in Saline Water

Direct Answer · 110R vs Dogridge Rootstock

Pick rootstock strictly by borewell Sodium (Na⁺) and soil lime — not blindly Dogridge. 110R and NRCG clone B2-56 actively exclude Na⁺ and sustain bud fruitfulness and Brix under drought/salinity, whereas 140Ru excels in shallow calcareous soils (18.47 kg/vine in Manjari Medika) and 1103P fits heavy moist clay [ICAR-NRCG; Somkuwar 2024–25].

ICAR-NRCG Warning

Do NOT Plant Dogridge Under Saline Borewells (ECw > 1.0 dS/m)

Dogridge gives vigorous early growth and bold berries in Years 2–3, but cannot block Na⁺ uptake. By Year 4–5, Na⁺ build-up locks out Potassium & Magnesium, causes marginal leaf burn, drops fruitfulness, and kills cordons. Likewise avoid SO4 (>85% mortality at 3,500 ppm NaCl).

Major Commercial Grape Varieties & Clones in India

Direct Answer · Commercial Grape Varieties

Green seedless Thompson Seedless and Tas-A-Ganesh / Clone 2A anchor EU/Gulf exports (135–160 days, ≥16°Brix), Sonaka/Manik Chaman lead domestic elongated fresh and long raisins, Sharad Seedless leads black seedless exports, Anushka harvests early (120–130 d), and Manjari Kishmish delivers 26.4% raisin recovery [ICAR-NRCG; APEDA 2026].

Extended Y-Trellis vs Bower, Trenching & Vines per Acre

Direct Answer · Grape Spacing & Extended Y-Trellis

Export vineyards use Extended Y-Trellis or Flat Roof Gable at 2.75 × 1.5 m (981 vines/acre) or 3.0 × 1.5 m (899 vines/acre). Splitting the canopy at 30°–40° increases sunlight on basal buds, cuts Downy/Powdery mildew microclimate humidity, and improves GA3 spray reach over traditional Bower (Pandal) systems [ICAR-NRCG; MANAGE].

Land Preparation, Trenching & In-Situ Grafting Protocol [TNAU; ICAR-NRCG]

Open 75 × 75 cm (2.5 × 2.5 ft) North–South trenches 1 month before planting. Mix topsoil with 40–55 t/ha FYM/compost + SSP + neem cake + Trichoderma. Plant certified rootstock in Jan–Feb, perform in-situ wedge grafting in Aug–Sep, and pinch 15 cm below the first wire to establish uniform primary arms.

Varieties, Rootstocks & Spacing FAQs

Which grape varieties dominate Indian exports and domestic acreage?

Thompson Seedless and its clones (Tas-A-Ganesh, Sonaka, Manik Chaman, Clone 2A) cover roughly 79% of Indian grape area, alongside Sharad Seedless (black), Crimson/Flame (red), early Anushka (120–130 d), ICAR-NRCG Manjari varieties, and Bangalore Blue [APEDA 2026; ICAR-NRCG].

Which rootstock performs best in shallow calcareous soils vs heavy black clay?

140Ru excels in shallow, calcareous semi-arid soils (highest Ca uptake and 18.47 kg/vine in Manjari Medika), 110R / B2-56 is the best all-rounder for saline water and drought, and 1103P fits heavy moist black clay [ICAR-NRCG; Somkuwar 2024–25].

Why is Extended Y-Trellis replacing traditional Bower (Pandal) systems?

Separating the canopy at 30°–40° on an Extended Y-Trellis or Flat Roof Gable increases sunlight on April basal buds, raises bud fruitfulness, drops Downy/Powdery mildew microclimate humidity, and improves GA3 spray coverage [ICAR-NRCG; MANAGE].

How many grapevines fit in 1 acre under Extended Y-Trellis vs Bower?

At 2.75 × 1.5 m (9 × 5 ft) you plant 981 vines/acre (2,425/ha); at 3.0 × 1.5 m (10 × 5 ft) you plant 899 vines/acre (2,222/ha); wide Bower (3.0 × 1.8 m) holds 749 vines/acre; and TN double-crop heavy Bowers (3.0 × 3.0 m) hold 450 vines/acre [ICAR-NRCG; TNAU].
